create_command: create a Command object with shell arguments and file redirects
build_pipeline: build a Pipeline of commands with optional negation and pipe error handling
resolve_glob: resolve a GlobItem pattern against a working directory using glob matching
generate_shell_output: generate shell script output from a Seq of commands with operators like ; or &&
test_command_equality: test Command and Pipeline equality by comparing args, redirects, and pipefail attributes
